steps.title: Bem-vindo: Shopping - Volume 45
steps.text: In this C2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Shopping". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
You can pay in twelve installments.
The cashier gave me the wrong change.
